description: The board your report already has the numbers for. Teams put a leaderboard on a screen because a rank is the one number everybody understands without training. Today they either hand-build a ranked table that looks like a spreadsheet, or they pay a gamification platform per user per month and export their Power BI data into it. SmartVisuals Leaderboard ends both. Bind an Entrant and a Value and you have a board. Bind a Period and it works out movement, streaks and personal bests by itself. No RANKX, no CALCULATE, no disconnected tables. A BOARD, NOT A TABLE Real rank numbers, a podium for the top three, medals, and a tie marker: two rows on 1,240 are both 5= and the board says so. Ties are a setting with a name: competition (1224), modified competition (1334), dense (1223) or ordinal. Ties are detected on the value the board prints, so two rows that both show 980 share a place unless you say otherwise. Row images at any size from a data: URI column, with an initials fallback so a missing photo is never a hole. Highest wins or lowest wins. Rank defects, response times or costs and a falling number reads as a climb. Top N with an Others row that cross-filters to every row it stands for. Quick styles set a league table, a sales-floor TV or an executive top ten in one click, and the colours take conditional formatting. WALL MODE Large type, auto-paging through a long list, a page…
